about: roofline prediction written BEFORE its run by report.js --roofline --predict; never edit the predicted block: score with --score and add a measured block beside it

conditions: same boot as tq-snoopy-unlock-ab-32k-unlocked (firmware toggled by the one-shot GRUB entry only), server freshly started, 2 warm-up prompts discarded, 3 prompts of ~36K fresh tokens at depth 0, same free VRAM and no desktop GPU load; the A/B ratio is the test

composition_backfill.about: added after the record, never part of its prediction: the per-chunk composition of the predicted block, made by the record's own RM commit (its src/model.js and data, instrumented to emit its chunk groups) and kept only because that model reproduced the predicted block exactly; frozen attribution reads it, since this record predates stored compositions
